inlines.v: SH'ARP-SET, adjective [sharp and set.] 1. Eager in appetite; affected by keen hunger; ravenous; as an eagle or a lion sharp-set. 2. Eager in the desire for gratification. The town is sharp-set on new plays. Pope.
